intro: Thunderhawk Wings are feathered trophies taken from the fierce wind serpents soaring above the central and southern Barrens. Presented to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo, they serve as definitive proof of a hunter's strength, cunning, and endurance in tracking down one of the savanna's most majestic predators.

p: Wind serpents, known to local hunters as thunderhawks, are formidable winged reptiles capable of striking swiftly from above. For the hunters stationed at Camp Taurajo, harvesting a pair of intact Thunderhawk Wings is far more than collecting biological scraps; it represents the culmination of grueling hunting trials in the Barrens. By tracking the aerial predators across the open plains and claiming their wings in combat, an initiate proves their readiness to walk the lifelong path of an accomplished hunter.
